  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [files, setFiles] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [aiLoading, setAiLoading] = useState(false);
  
  // Draft State
  const [draftId, setDraftId] = useState(null);
  
  // Poll State
  const [pollQ, setPollQ] = useState('');
  const [pollOpts, setPollOpts] = useState(['', '']);

  // Filter State
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('');

  // Hashtag Autocomplete
  const [tagSuggestions, setTagSuggestions] = useState([]);
  const [isPaywalled, setIsPaywalled] = useState(false);
  const [unlockPrice, setUnlockPrice] = useState(10);

  // AI Creator Studio State
  const [selectedTone, setSelectedTone] = useState('obsidian');
  const [showAiStudio, setShowAiStudio] = useState(false);
  const [aspectRatio, setAspectRatio] = useState('1:1'); // '1:1' | '4:5' | '16:9'

  const { add } = useToast();
  const currentUser = useSelector((s) => s.auth?.user);

  // Auto-restore saved draft
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialData && isOpen && !text) {
      const savedDraft = localStorage.getItem('socialverse_draft_post');
      if (savedDraft) setText(savedDraft);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Auto-save draft
  useEffect(() => {
    if (text) {
      localStorage.setItem('socialverse_draft_post', text);
    }
  }, [text]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialTab) {
      if (initialTab === 'poll') setActiveTab('poll');
      else if (initialTab === 'reel') setActiveTab('reel');
      else if (initialTab === 'ai') {
        setActiveTab('post');
        setShowAiStudio(true);
      } else {
        setActiveTab('post');
      }
    }
  }, [initialTab]);

  // 🔥 EFFECT: Load Initial Data (Drafts/Reposts/AI Prompt)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialData) {
        setText(initialData.content || (typeof initialData === 'string' ? initialData : ''));
        if (initialData.openAiStudio) setShowAiStudio(true);
        if (initialData.isDraft) setDraftId(initialData._id); // Track draft ID
    } else if (!isOpen) {
        // Reset on close
        setText(''); 
        setFiles([]); 
        setPollQ(''); 
        setPollOpts(['','']); 
        setFilter(''); 
        setTagSuggestions([]); 
        setDraftId(null);
        setShowAiStudio(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, initialData]);

  // 🔥 Handle File Selection with NSFW Check
  const handleFileSelect = async (e, type) => {
    const selectedFiles = Array.from(e.target.files);
    if (selectedFiles.length === 0) return;

    if (type === 'image') {
        setLoading(true);
        try {
            const file = selectedFiles[0];
            const img = document.createElement('img');
            img.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
            img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';

            const isUnsafe = await new Promise((resolve) => {
                img.onload = async () => {
                    try {
                        const result = await checkImageSafety(img);
                        resolve(result);
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error("NSFW Check Error", error);
                        resolve(false);
                    }
                };
                img.onerror = () => resolve(false);
            });

            if (isUnsafe) {
                add("Image blocked: Contains inappropriate content.", { type: 'error' });
                e.target.value = "";
                setFiles([]);
            } else {
                setFiles(selectedFiles);
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error("File processing error", err);
            setFiles(selectedFiles); 
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    } else {
        setFiles(selectedFiles);
    }
  };

  // Handle Hashtag Detection
  const handleTextChange = async (e) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setText(val);

    const words = val.split(/[\s\n]+/);
    const lastWord = words[words.length - 1];

    if (lastWord.startsWith('#') && lastWord.length > 1) {
        const query = lastWord.slice(1);
        try {
            const res = await API.get(`/tags/search?q=${query}`);
            setTagSuggestions(res.data || []);
        } catch(e) { /* silent fail */ }
    } else {
        setTagSuggestions([]);
    }
  };

  const insertTag = (tag) => {
    const words = text.split(/[\s\n]+/);
    words.pop(); 
    const newText = words.join(' ') + ' #' + tag + ' ';
    setText(newText);
    setTagSuggestions([]);
  };

  const handleMagicWrite = async (customTone = selectedTone) => {
    setAiLoading(true);
    try {
      const caption = await generateCaption(text, customTone); 
      setText(caption);
      add(`AI composed in ${customTone} tone!`, { type: 'success' });
    } catch(e) {
      add("AI unavailable", { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setAiLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAppendSmartTags = () => {
    const tags = generateSmartTags(text);
    const tagStr = tags.map(t => `#${t}`).join(' ');
    setText(prev => (prev ? `${prev.trim()}\n\n${tagStr}` : tagStr));
    add("Smart hashtags appended!", { type: 'info' });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (isSaveDraft = false) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();

      if (activeTab === 'poll') {
        if (!pollQ || pollOpts.some(o => !o.trim())) throw new Error("Incomplete poll data");
        await API.post('/polls', { question: pollQ, options: pollOpts });
      } 
      else if (activeTab === 'reel') {
         if (files.length === 0) throw new Error("Video required for Reel");
         fd.append('video', files[0]);
         fd.append('caption', text);
         await API.post('/reels/upload', fd);
      } 
      else {
         fd.append('content', text);
         fd.append('isDraft', isSaveDraft);
         fd.append('isPaywalled', isPaywalled);
         fd.append('unlockPrice', unlockPrice); 
         
         for (const f of files) {
             const processed = await compressImage(f);
             fd.append('media', processed);
         }

         await API.post('/posts', fd);
      }

      if (!isSaveDraft) {
        localStorage.removeItem('socialverse_draft_post');
      }
      if (onPosted) onPosted();
      onClose();
      add(isSaveDraft ? 'Draft saved!' : 'Posted successfully!', { type: 'success' });
    } catch(err) {
      console.error(err);
      add(err.response?.data?.message || err.message || "Failed to post", { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md">
      <motion.div 
        initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }} 
        animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} 
        className="w-full max-w-xl bg-[#070B14] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.16)] rounded-[24px] shadow-[0_24px_80px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85)] overflow-hidden max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar text-[#F8FAFC]"
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] flex justify-between items-center bg-[#04070D] sticky top-0 z-10">
          <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-center w-full text-[#F8FAFC]">Create Content</h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-white/[0.08] text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:text-white absolute right-4 transition-colors"><FaTimes /></button>
        </div>

        <div className="p-5">
          {/* Tabs */}
          <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4 bg-[#04070D] p-1.5 rounded-[14px] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)]">
            {['post', 'reel', 'poll'].map(tab => (
              <button 
                key={tab}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab)}
                className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-[10px] text-sm font-semibold capitalize transition-all ${
                  activeTab === tab 
                    ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8]/25 to-[#00F2FE]/20 border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.15)] text-[#00F2FE] font-bold shadow-sm' 
                    : 'text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:text-[#F8FAFC]'
                }`}
              >
                {tab}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* User Info */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <UserAvatar src={currentUser?.avatar} name={currentUser?.name} className="w-10 h-10 border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.15)]" />
            <div>
              <div className="font-bold text-sm text-[#F8FAFC]">{currentUser?.name || 'You'}</div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/70 bg-[#04070D] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] px-2 py-0.5 rounded cursor-pointer mt-0.5">
                <FaGlobeAmericas /> Public
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* --- POLL UI --- */}
          {activeTab === 'poll' ? (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <input 
                className="w-full p-3 rounded-[14px] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#04070D] text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00F2FE] transition-all" 
                placeholder="Ask a question..." 
                value={pollQ} 
                onChange={e=>setPollQ(e.target.value)} 
              />
              {pollOpts.map((o,i)=>(
                <input 
                  key={i} 
                  className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-[12px] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#04070D] text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00F2FE] transition-all" 
                  placeholder={`Option ${i+1}`} 
                  value={o} 
                  onChange={e=>{ const newOpts=[...pollOpts]; newOpts[i]=e.target.value; setPollOpts(newOpts); }} 
                />
              ))}
              <button type="button" onClick={()=>setPollOpts([...pollOpts,''])} className="text-sm text-[#00F2FE] font-bold hover:underline">+ Add Option</button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* --- POST / REEL UI --- */
            <>
              <div className="relative">
                <textarea 
                  value={text}
                  onChange={handleTextChange}
                  placeholder={activeTab === 'reel' ? "Describe your reel..." : "What's on your mind? (Try typing #)"}
                  className="w-full h-24 bg-transparent text-lg resize-none outline-none placeholder-[#CBD5E1]/40 text-[#F8FAFC]"
                />
                
                {/* Autocomplete Dropdown */}
                {tagSuggestions.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="absolute z-10 bg-[#070B14] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] shadow-2xl rounded-xl p-2 mt-1 left-0 w-64 max-h-40 overflow-y-auto">
                        {tagSuggestions.map(tag => (
                            <button key={tag} onClick={() => insertTag(tag)} className="block w-full text-left px-3 py-2 hover:bg-white/[0.06] rounded text-sm text-[#00F2FE] font-medium transition">
                                #{tag}
                            </button>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pb-2">
                  <button 
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowAiStudio(prev => !prev)}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition border ${
                      showAiStudio 
                        ? 'bg-[#D4AF37]/20 text-[#D4AF37] border-[#D4AF37]/50 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(212,140,123,0.3)]' 
                        : 'border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] text-[#CBD5E1]/70 hover:text-[#D4AF37]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <FaMagic className={aiLoading ? "animate-spin text-[#D4AF37]" : "text-[#D4AF37]"} />
                    <span>AI Studio</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Expanded AI Creator Studio Panel */}
                {showAiStudio && (
                  <motion.div 
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -6 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    className="mb-3 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#04070D] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.12)] space-y-2.5"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CBD5E1]/70">
                        AI Tone & Voice
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-[#0F766E] font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
                        🛡️ 99.4% Safety Cleared
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Tone Chips */}
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                      {AI_TONES.map(tone => (
                        <button
                          key={tone.id}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setSelectedTone(tone.id);
                            handleMagicWrite(tone.id);
                          }}
                          disabled={aiLoading}
                          className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition ${
                            selectedTone === tone.id
                              ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#00F2FE] text-white font-bold shadow-sm'
                              : 'bg-[#070B14] text-[#CBD5E1] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.12)] hover:border-[#00F2FE]/40'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span>{tone.icon}</span>
                          <span>{tone.label}</span>
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 text-xs">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={handleAppendSmartTags}
                        className="text-[#D4AF37] hover:underline font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"
                      >
                        🏷️ Append Smart Hashtags
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleMagicWrite(selectedTone)}
                        disabled={aiLoading}
                        className="text-[#00F2FE] hover:underline font-bold"
                      >
                        {aiLoading ? 'Crafting...' : '✨ Rewrite Draft'}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </motion.div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Media Preview */}
              {files.length > 0 && (
                <div className="mb-4">
                  {/* Aspect Ratio Toggle Bar */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CBD5E1]/60">
                      Framing Ratio
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex gap-1.5 bg-[#04070D] p-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 text-xs">
                      {['1:1', '4:5', '16:9'].map((ratio) => (
                        <button
                          key={ratio}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setAspectRatio(ratio)}
                          className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                            aspectRatio === ratio
                              ? 'bg-[#00F2FE]/20 text-[#00F2FE] border border-[#00F2FE]/40'
                              : 'text-white/60 hover:text-white'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {ratio}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className={`relative w-full rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-black group ${
                    aspectRatio === '1:1' ? 'h-64 sm:h-72' : aspectRatio === '4:5' ? 'h-80 sm:h-96' : 'h-48 sm:h-56'
                  }`}>
                    <button onClick={() => setFiles([])} className="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-black/60 text-white p-1 rounded-full z-20 hover:bg-[#052E24] transition cursor-pointer"><FaTimes /></button>
                    {files[0].type.includes('video') ? (
                      <video src={URL.createObjectURL(files[0])} className="h-full w-full object-cover" controls />
                    ) : (
                      <img 
                        src={URL.createObjectURL(files[0])} 
                        className={`h-full w-full ${aspectRatio === '1:1' ? 'object-cover' : 'object-contain'} transition-all duration-300`}
                        style={{ filter: filter }}
                        alt="preview"
                      />
                    )}
                  </div>
                  {/* Filters */}
                  {!files[0].type.includes('video') && (
                    <div className="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto py-3 no-scrollbar">
                      {FILTERS.map(f => (
                        <button key={f.name} onClick={() => setFilter(f.val)} className={`px-4 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold border transition whitespace-nowrap ${filter === f.val ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#00F2FE] text-white border-transparent' : 'border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:border-[#00F2FE]'}`}>
                          {f.name}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Tools Bar */}
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center border p-3 rounded-xl border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-[#04070D] mt-2">
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-[#CBD5E1]/70">
                    {loading ? 'Checking...' : 'Add to your post'}
                </span>
                <div className="flex gap-3 text-xl">
                  {/* Image Upload Input */}
                  <label className={`cursor-pointer text-[#00F2FE] hover:bg-white/[0.06] p-2 rounded-full transition ${loading ? 'opacity-50 pointer-events-none' : ''}`}>
                    <FaImage />
                    <input 
                        type="file" 
                        accept="image/*" 
                        className="hidden" 
                        multiple={activeTab!=='reel'} 
                        onChange={e => handleFileSelect(e, 'image')}
                    />
                  </label>
                  
                  {/* Video Upload Input */}
                  <label className={`cursor-pointer text-[#10B981] hover:bg-white/[0.06] p-2 rounded-full transition ${loading ? 'opacity-50 pointer-events-none' : ''}`}>
                    <FaVideo />
                    <input 
                        type="file" 
                        accept="video/*" 
                        className="hidden" 
                        onChange={e => handleFileSelect(e, 'video')}
                    />
                  </label>
                  
<div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setIsPaywalled(!isPaywalled)}
                      className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition ${
                        isPaywalled 
                          ? 'border-[#D4AF37] bg-[#D4AF37]/20 text-[#F4D49A]' 
                          : 'border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-[#CBD5E1]/60 hover:text-white'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <FaMagic size={11} className={isPaywalled ? "text-[#F4D49A]" : ""} />
                      <span>{isPaywalled ? `${unlockPrice} Coins Paywall` : 'VIP Paywall'}</span>
                    </button>
                    {isPaywalled && (
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min="1"
                        max="1000"
                        value={unlockPrice}
                        onChange={(e) => setUnlockPrice(Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 1))}
                        className="w-16 rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-[#04070D] px-2 py-1 text-center text-xs font-bold text-[#F4D49A] outline-none"
                      />
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <button className="text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-white/[0.06] p-2 rounded-full transition"><FaPoll /></button>
                  <button className="text-[#CBD5E1] hover:bg-white/[0.06] p-2 rounded-full transition"><FaSmile /></button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          <div className="flex gap-3 mt-6">
            {/* Draft Button (Only for posts) */}
            {activeTab === 'post' && (
                <button 
                    disabled={loading || !text}
                    onClick={() => handleSubmit(true)} 
                    className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] bg-white/[0.06] text-[#CBD5E1] font-bold hover:bg-white/[0.1] transition-colors"
                >
                    Save Draft
                </button>
            )}
            
            {/* Post Button */}
            <button 
                disabled={loading || (activeTab==='poll' ? !pollQ : (!text && files.length === 0))}
                onClick={() => handleSubmit(false)}
                className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#2563EB] to-[#00F2FE] hover:opacity-95 text-white font-bold disabled:opacity-50 transition shadow-sapphireGlow"
            >
                {loading ? 'Processing...' : 'Post'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/posts/EditPostModal.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import { FaTimes, FaTrash, FaPlus } from 'react-icons/fa';

export default function EditPostModal({ isOpen, onClose, post, onUpdated }) {
  const [content, setContent] = useState(post?.content || '');
  const [mediaToRemove, setMediaToRemove] = useState([]);
  const [newFiles, setNewFiles] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const { add } = useToast();

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const activeImages = (post?.images || []).filter(img => !mediaToRemove.includes(img));

  const toggleRemove = (imgUrl) => {
    if (mediaToRemove.includes(imgUrl)) {
        setMediaToRemove(prev => prev.filter(i => i !== imgUrl));
    } else {
        setMediaToRemove(prev => [...prev, imgUrl]);
    }
  };

  const handleFileChange = (e) => {
      if (e.target.files) {
          setNewFiles(prev => [...prev, ...Array.from(e.target.files)]);
      }
  };

  const removeNewFile = (index) => {
      setNewFiles(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const handleUpdate = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('content', content);
      newFiles.forEach(f => fd.append('media', f));
      mediaToRemove.forEach(url => fd.append('imagesToRemove', url));

      await API.put(`/posts/${post._id}`, fd, { 
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } 
      });
      
      add('Post updated successfully', { type: 'success' });
      if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      add(e.userMessage || 'Failed to update post', { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl p-4">
      <motion.div 
        initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }} 
        animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} 
        className="w-full max-w-lg p-6 relative rounded-3xl bg-[#070B14]/95 border border-white/15 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-2xl"
      >
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 pb-3 border-b border-white/10">
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[#F7F7FC]">Edit Broadcast</h3>
            <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1.5 text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F7F7FC] rounded-full transition">
                <FaTimes size={14} />
            </button>
        </div>
        
        {/* Content Input */}
        <textarea 
          value={content} 
          onChange={(e) => setContent(e.target.value)} 
          className="w-full p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#0A111E] border border-white/10 text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB] outline-none focus:border-[#00F2FE]/50 h-32 resize-none mb-4 leading-relaxed transition"
          placeholder="What's on your mind?"
        />

        {/* Existing Images Management */}
        {(activeImages.length > 0 || mediaToRemove.length > 0) && (
            <div className="mb-4">
                <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#A5A9BB] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Current Media</p>
                <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-thin">
                    {activeImages.map((img, i) => (
                        <div key={i} className="relative w-20 h-20 flex-shrink-0 group rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-white/10 bg-black/40">
                            <img src={img} className="w-full h-full object-cover transition" alt="post media" />
                            <button 
                                onClick={() => toggleRemove(img)}
                                className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 flex items-center justify-center text-[#F87171] transition"
                                title="Remove Image"
                            >
                                <FaTrash size={12} />
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                    {mediaToRemove.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-center px-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-[#F87171] bg-[#052E24]/15 rounded-xl border border-[#052E24]/30">
                            {mediaToRemove.length} to remove
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
            </div>
        )}

        {/* Add New Media */}
        <div className="mb-6">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#A5A9BB] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Add Media</p>
            <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto">
                <label className="w-20 h-20 flex-shrink-0 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-white/20 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer hover:border-[#00F2FE]/50 transition text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#00F2FE] bg-[#0A111E]">
                    <FaPlus size={14} />
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold mt-1">Add</span>
                    <input type="file" multiple accept="image/*" className="hidden" onChange={handleFileChange} />
                </label>

                {newFiles.map((f, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className="relative w-20 h-20 flex-shrink-0 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-white/10 group">
                        <img src={URL.createObjectURL(f)} className="w-full h-full object-cover opacity-80" alt="preview" />
                        <button 
                            onClick={() => removeNewFile(i)}
                            className="absolute top-1 right-1 bg-[#052E24] text-white p-1 rounded-full shadow-md hover:scale-110 transition"
                        >
                            <FaTimes size={8} />
                        </button>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer Actions */}
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2 border-t border-white/10">
          <button 
            onClick={onClose} 
            className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F7F7FC] transition"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button 
            onClick={handleUpdate} 
            disabled={loading} 
            className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#D4AF37] text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-md hover:opacity-95 transition disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {loading ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Changes'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/posts/LikesModal.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaTimes, FaHeart } from 'react-icons/fa';
import UserAvatar from '../ui/UserAvatar';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import FollowButton from '../profile/FollowButton';

export default function LikesModal({ isOpen, onClose, postId }) {
  const [users, setUsers] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && postId) {
      setLoading(true);
      API.get(`/posts/${postId}/likes`)
         .then(res => {
           const payload = res.data?.data || res.data;
           setUsers(Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : []);
         })
         .catch(() => setUsers([]))
         .finally(() => setLoading(false));
    }
  }, [isOpen, postId]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl p-4">
      <motion.div 
        initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }} 
        animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} 
        className="bg-[#070B14]/95 border border-white/15 w-full max-w-sm rounded-3xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[60vh] overflow-hidden backdrop-blur-2xl"
      >
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/10 flex justify-between items-center bg-[#171A26]/50">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[#F7F7FC] flex items-center gap-2">
            <FaHeart className="text-[#10B981]" /> Liked By
          </h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F7F7FC] transition">
            <FaTimes size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 space-y-1">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="p-8 text-center text-xs text-[#A5A9BB]">Loading audience...</div>
          ) : users.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-8 text-center text-xs text-[#A5A9BB]">No likes recorded yet.</div>
          ) : (
            users.map(u => (
              <div key={u._id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 hover:bg-white/5 rounded-2xl transition">
                <Link to={`/profile/${u._id}`} onClick={onClose} className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <UserAvatar src={u.avatar} name={u.name} className="w-9 h-9 border border-white/10" />
                  <span className="font-semibold text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] truncate">{u.name}</span>
                </Link>
                <FollowButton userId={u._id} />
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/posts/PostActionSheet.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaEdit, FaTrash, FaExclamationTriangle } from 'react-icons/fa';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import ReportModal from '../ui/ReportModal';
import EditPostModal from './EditPostModal';

export default function PostActionSheet({ post, isMine, onClose }) {
  const { add } = useToast();
  const [showReport, setShowReport] = useState(false);
  const [showEdit, setShowEdit] = useState(false);

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to delete this post?")) return;
    try {
      await API.delete(`/posts/${post._id}`);
      add("Post deleted", { type: 'success' });
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('postDeleted', { detail: post._id }));
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      add("Failed to delete", { type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl" onClick={onClose}>
        <motion.div 
          initial={{ y: "100%" }} 
          animate={{ y: 0 }} 
          exit={{ y: "100%" }} 
          onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
          className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-[#070B14]/95 border-t border-white/15 rounded-t-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl max-w-md mx-auto backdrop-blur-2xl"
        >
          <div className="p-3.5 border-b border-white/5 flex justify-center">
            <div className="w-12 h-1.5 bg-white/20 rounded-full" />
          </div>

          <div className="p-2 space-y-1">
            {isMine ? (
              <>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => setShowEdit(true)} 
                  className="w-full p-4 flex items-center gap-3.5 hover:bg-white/5 rounded-2xl transition font-medium text-xs text-[#F7F7FC]"
                >
                  <FaEdit className="text-[#00F2FE]" size={14} /> Edit Broadcast
                </button>
                <button 
                  onClick={handleDelete} 
                  className="w-full p-4 flex items-center gap-3.5 hover:bg-[#052E24]/20 rounded-2xl transition font-medium text-xs text-[#F87171]"
                >
                  <FaTrash size={14} /> Delete Broadcast
                </button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <button 
                onClick={() => setShowReport(true)} 
                className="w-full p-4 flex items-center gap-3.5 hover:bg-[#052E24]/20 rounded-2xl transition font-medium text-xs text-[#F87171]"
              >
                <FaExclamationTriangle size={14} /> Report Content
              </button>
            )}
            
            <div className="h-px bg-white/10 my-1" />
            
            <button 
              onClick={onClose} 
              className="w-full p-3.5 font-bold text-xs text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F7F7FC] hover:bg-white/5 rounded-2xl transition"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      </div>

      {showReport && <ReportModal isOpen={true} onClose={() => { setShowReport(false); onClose(); }} targetPostId={post._id} />}
      
      {showEdit && (
        <EditPostModal 
            isOpen={true} 
            onClose={() => { setShowEdit(false); onClose(); }} 
            post={post}
            onUpdated={() => {
                window.location.reload();
            }} 
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/posts/PostCard.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, forwardRef } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { useSelector } from "react-redux";
import { formatDistanceToNow } from "date-fns";
import { 
  IoHeart, 
  IoHeartOutline, 
  IoChatbubbleOutline, 
  IoShareSocialOutline, 
  IoBookmarkOutline, 
  IoBookmark, 
  IoEllipsisHorizontal, 
  IoPlay, 
  IoVolumeMute, 
  IoVolumeHigh,
  IoEyeOutline,
  IoChevronBack,
  IoChevronForward
} from "react-icons/io5";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import API from "../../services/api";

import { useToast } from "../ui/ToastProvider";
import UserAvatar from "../ui/UserAvatar";
import { FaGem, FaLock, FaCoins } from "react-icons/fa";
import TipModal from "../wallet/TipModal";
import Lightbox from "../ui/Lightbox";
import LinkPreviewCard from "../ui/LinkPreviewCard";
import PostActionSheet from "./PostActionSheet";
import { getImageUrl } from "../../utils/imageUtils";
import { playCyberClick, playHeartPop, playSuccessChord } from "../../utils/soundEffects";

const PostCard = forwardRef(({ post }, ref) => {
  const { user } = useSelector((s) => s.auth);
  const { add: toast } = useToast();

  // Local State
  const [localPost, setLocalPost] = useState(post);
  const [isLiked, setIsLiked] = useState(post.likes?.includes(user?._id));
  const [reactionEmoji, setReactionEmoji] = useState(null);
  const [isTranslated, setIsTranslated] = useState(false);
  const [translatedText, setTranslatedText] = useState(null);
  const [showReactions, setShowReactions] = useState(false);
  const [likeCount, setLikeCount] = useState(post.likes?.length || 0);
  const [isSaved, setIsSaved] = useState(Boolean(post.isSaved || post.saved)); 
  const [showHeartOverlay, setShowHeartOverlay] = useState(false);
  const [showActions, setShowActions] = useState(false);
  const [lightboxImg, setLightboxImg] = useState(null);
  const [activeImgIdx, setActiveImgIdx] = useState(0);
  const [isUnlocking, setIsUnlocking] = useState(false);

  // Video State
  const videoRef = useRef(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(true);
  const [showTipModal, setShowTipModal] = useState(false);

  const isMine = post.user?._id === user?._id;
  const isPaywalledLocked =
    Boolean(localPost.isPaywalled) &&
    !isMine &&
    !(localPost.unlockedBy || []).some((u) => (u?._id || u) === user?._id);

  const handleUnlockPost = async (e) => {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    try {
      setIsUnlocking(true);
      playCyberClick();
      const res = await API.post('/posts/' + post._id + '/unlock');
      playSuccessChord();
      toast('VIP Content unlocked!', { type: 'success' });
      setLocalPost((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        isPaywalled: false,
        unlockedBy: [...(prev.unlockedBy || []), user?._id]
      }));
    } catch (err) {
      toast(err.response?.data?.message || 'Insufficient coin balance to unlock', { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setIsUnlocking(false);
    }
  };

  // Poll Calculation
  const totalVotes = localPost.poll?.options?.reduce(
    (sum, opt) => sum + (opt.votes?.length || 0), 
    0
  ) || 0;

  // Sync props to state
  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalPost(post);
    setIsLiked(post.likes?.includes(user?._id));
    setLikeCount(post.likes?.length || 0);
    setIsSaved(Boolean(post.isSaved || post.saved));
  }, [post, user?._id]);

  // View Counter Effect
  useEffect(() => {
    API.post(`/posts/${post._id}/view`).catch(() => {});
  }, [post._id]);



  // Auto-pause video when scrolling away
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!videoRef.current) return;

    const obs = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting && !videoRef.current.paused) {
          videoRef.current.pause();
          setIsPlaying(false);
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.6 }
    );
    obs.observe(videoRef.current);
    return () => obs.disconnect();
  }, []);

  // --- HANDLERS ---

  const handleToggleTranslate = async () => {
    if (isTranslated) {
      setIsTranslated(false);
      return;
    }
    if (translatedText) {
      setIsTranslated(true);
      return;
    }
    try {
      const res = await API.post('/translate', { text: post.content, targetLang: 'en' });
      const translated = res.data?.translatedText || res.data?.translation || post.content;
      setTranslatedText(translated);
      setIsTranslated(true);
    } catch (_) {
      // Friendly local fallback
      setTranslatedText(post.content);
      setIsTranslated(true);
    }
  };
  const handleLike = async () => {
    playCyberClick();
    const prev = isLiked;
    setIsLiked(!prev);
    setLikeCount((c) => (prev ? c - 1 : c + 1));
    
    if (!prev) {
      if (window.navigator?.vibrate) window.navigator.vibrate(50);
    }

    try {
      await API.put(`/posts/like/${post._id}`);
    } catch {
      setIsLiked(prev);
      setLikeCount((c) => (prev ? c + 1 : c - 1));
    }
  };

  const handleDoubleTap = () => {
    playHeartPop();
    if (!isLiked) handleLike();
    setShowHeartOverlay(true);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    playCyberClick();
    const prev = isSaved;
    setIsSaved(!prev);

    try {
      const res = await API.post(`/posts/${post._id}/bookmark`);
      const savedState = res.data?.saved ?? !prev;
      setIsSaved(savedState);
      toast(savedState ? "Saved" : "Removed from saved", { type: "success" });
    } catch {
      setIsSaved(prev);
    }
  };

  const handleShare = async () => {
    const data = {
      title: `Post by ${post.user.name}`,
      text: post.content,
      url: `${window.location.origin}/post/${post._id}`,
    };

    if (navigator.share) {
      try {
        await navigator.share(data);
        toast("Shared successfully", { type: "success" });
      } catch {}
    } else {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(data.url);
      toast("Link copied to clipboard", { type: "success" });
    }
  };

  const handleVote = async (index) => {
    try {
      playSuccessChord();
      setLocalPost((prev) => {
        if (!prev?.poll?.options) return prev;
        const newOptions = prev.poll.options.map((opt, i) => {
          const currentVotes = Array.isArray(opt.votes) ? [...opt.votes] : [];
          if (i === index && !currentVotes.includes(user?._id || "guest_user")) {
            currentVotes.push(user?._id || "guest_user");
          }
          return { ...opt, votes: currentVotes };
        });
        return {
          ...prev,
          poll: { ...prev.poll, options: newOptions }
        };
      });
      toast("Vote recorded!", { type: "success" });
      if (post._id && !String(post._id).startsWith("showcase")) {
        await API.post(`/polls/${post._id}/vote/${index}`);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  // Helper to render hashtags and mentions
  const renderContent = (txt) => {
    if (!txt) return null;
    return txt.split(/(\s+)/).map((p, i) => {
      if (p.startsWith("#")) {
        return (
          <Link 
            key={i} 
            to={`/tags/${p.slice(1)}`} 
            className="text-primary font-bold hover:underline decoration-primary/50"
          >
            {p}
          </Link>
        );
      }
      if (p.startsWith("@")) {
        return (
          <Link 
            key={i} 
            to={`/profile/${p.slice(1)}`} 
            className="text-secondary font-bold hover:underline decoration-secondary/50"
          >
            {p}
          </Link>
        );
      }
      return p;
    });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <motion.div 
        ref={ref}
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }} 
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -16 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
        className="relative group overflow-hidden rounded-[26px] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.15)] bg-[#0A111E]/85 backdrop-blur-2xl shadow-[0_16px_48px_rgba(0,0,0,0.55)] p-5 md:p-6 mb-6 transition-all duration-240 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.32)] hover:shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.7),0_0_25px_rgba(29,78,216,0.18)] group/card"
      >
        {/* === HEADER === */}
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-4 relative z-10">
          <Link to={`/profile/${post.user._id}`} className="flex items-center gap-3 group/user">
            <div className="relative">
              {/* Masterpiece Signature Avatar Ring on Hover */}
              <div className="absolute -inset-0.5 bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#D4AF37] rounded-full blur-[2px] opacity-0 group-hover/user:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300"/>
              <UserAvatar 
                src={post.user?.avatar} 
                name={post.user?.name} 
                userId={post.user?._id}
                className="relative w-10 h-10 border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.2)]" 
              />
            </div>
            <div className="leading-tight">
              <p className="font-display font-semibold text-[15px] text-[#F8FAFC] group-hover/user:text-[#00F2FE] transition-colors">
                {post.user.name}
              </p>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/75 font-medium mt-0.5">
                <span>{formatDistanceToNow(new Date(post.createdAt), { addSuffix: true })}</span>
                {post.views > 0 && isMine && (
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#070B14] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.12)] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[#CBD5E1]">
                    <IoEyeOutline /> {post.views}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </Link>

          <button 
            onClick={() => setShowActions(true)} 
            className="p-2 rounded-full text-[#CBD5E1] hover:text-[#F8FAFC] hover:bg-[#070B14] border border-transparent hover:border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)] transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <IoEllipsisHorizontal size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* === CONTENT TEXT === */}
        {post.content && (
          <div className="pb-3 text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-[#F8FAFC]/95 whitespace-pre-wrap relative z-10 selection:bg-[#1D4ED8]/40">
            {renderContent(isTranslated && translatedText ? translatedText : post.content)}
          </div>
        )}
        
        <div className="pb-4 relative z-10">
          <LinkPreviewCard text={post.content} />
        </div>

        {/* === PREMIUM MEDIA SECTION === */}
        {((post.images && post.images.length > 0) || post.mediaUrl || (post.videos && post.videos.length > 0)) && (
          <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-[20px] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.15)] my-4 aspect-video bg-black/40 z-10 cursor-pointer group/media" onDoubleClick={handleDoubleTap}>
            {/* Dark Red Heart Explosion Overlay */}
            <AnimatePresence>
              {showHeartOverlay && (
                <motion.div 
                  initial={{ scale: 0, opacity: 0, rotate: -25 }}
                  animate={{ scale: [0, 1.4, 1], opacity: [0, 1, 0.95], rotate: 0 }}
                  exit={{ scale: 0.6, opacity: 0 }}
                  transition={{ type: "spring", damping: 14, stiffness: 220, duration: 0.7 }}
                  onAnimationComplete={() => setShowHeartOverlay(false)}
                  className="absolute inset-0 z-30 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none"
                >
                  <IoHeart className="text-[#EF4444] drop-shadow-[0_0_45px_rgba(239,68,68,0.95)] text-9xl filter" />
                </motion.div>
              )}
            </AnimatePresence>

            {/* --- IMAGE RENDER (CAROUSEL) --- */}
            {((post.images && post.images.length > 0) || post.mediaUrl) && (() => {
              const imgList = (post.images && post.images.length > 0) ? post.images : (post.mediaUrl ? [post.mediaUrl] : []);
              const currentImg = imgList[activeImgIdx] || imgList[0];
              return (
                <div className="relative w-full h-full">
                  <img
                    src={getImageUrl(currentImg, "feed")}
                    alt="Post media content"
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover/media:scale-[1.01]"
                    loading="lazy"
                    decoding="async"
                    onClick={() => setLightboxImg(currentImg)}
                  />

                  {imgList.length > 1 && (
                    <>
                      {/* Counter Badge */}
                      <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 z-20 rounded-full bg-black/60 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-white backdrop-blur-md">
                        {activeImgIdx + 1}/{imgList.length}
                      </div>

                      {/* Prev Button */}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          setActiveImgIdx((prev) => (prev === 0 ? imgList.length - 1 : prev - 1));
                        }}
                        className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-20 flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-black/50 text-white backdrop-blur-sm transition-all hover:bg-black/80 hover:scale-110 active:scale-95"
                      >
                        <IoChevronBack size={18} />
                      </button>

                      {/* Next Button */}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          setActiveImgIdx((prev) => (prev === imgList.length - 1 ? 0 : prev + 1));
                        }}
                        className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-20 flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-black/50 text-white backdrop-blur-sm transition-all hover:bg-black/80 hover:scale-110 active:scale-95"
                      >
                        <IoChevronForward size={18} />
                      </button>

                      {/* Dots */}
                      <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-20 flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-black/40 px-2 py-1 backdrop-blur-sm">
                        {imgList.map((_, dotIdx) => (
                          <div
                            key={dotIdx}
                            className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                              dotIdx === activeImgIdx ? 'w-4 bg-white' : 'w-1.5 bg-white/50'
                            }`}
                          />
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })()}

            {/* VIP Frosted Glass Paywall Overlay */}
            {isPaywalledLocked && (
              <div 
                onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} 
                className="absolute inset-0 z-30 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-[#04070D]/85 backdrop-blur-2xl p-6 text-center select-none"
              >
                <div className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-[#D4AF37]/20 border border-[#D4AF37]/40 text-[#F4D49A] shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(212,140,123,0.3)] mb-3">
                  <FaLock size={22} className="animate-pulse" />
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#D4AF37]">
                  VIP EXCLUSIVE CONTENT
                </span>
                <h4 className="text-base font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] mt-1 mb-1.5 font-display">
                  Curated Creator Paywall
                </h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/70 max-w-xs mb-4">
                  Unlock this exclusive media directly and support @{post.user?.username || 'creator'}.
                </p>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleUnlockPost}
                  disabled={isUnlocking}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FEF3C7] via-[#D4AF37] to-[#10B981] px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-black text-[#04070D] shadow-lg shadow-[#D4AF37]/25 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <FaCoins className="text-[#F4D49A]" />
                  <span>{isUnlocking ? 'Decrypting Access...' : 'Unlock for ' + (localPost.unlockPrice || 10) + ' Coins'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* --- VIDEO RENDER --- */}
            {post.videos?.[0] && (
              <div className="relative w-full h-full bg-black">
                <video
                  ref={videoRef}
                  src={getImageUrl(post.videos[0])}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                  loop 
                  muted={muted} 
                  playsInline
                  onClick={() => {
                     if(videoRef.current.paused) { videoRef.current.play(); setIsPlaying(true); } 
                     else { videoRef.current.pause(); setIsPlaying(false); }
                  }}
                  onPlay={() => setIsPlaying(true)}
                  onPause={() => setIsPlaying(false)}
                />
                
                {/* Play Button Overlay (Only when paused) */}
                {!isPlaying && (
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/20 backdrop-blur-[1px] pointer-events-none transition-opacity duration-300">
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center border border-white/30 shadow-glow-lg group-hover/media:scale-110 transition-transform">
                      <IoPlay className="text-white ml-1 text-3xl" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Mute Toggle */}
                <button 
                  onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setMuted(!muted); }}
                  className="absolute bottom-4 right-4 p-2.5 rounded-full bg-black/50 text-white backdrop-blur-sm hover:bg-black/70 transition-colors z-20"
                >
                  {muted ? <IoVolumeMute size={20} /> : <IoVolumeHigh size={20} />}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* === POLL SECTION === */}
        {localPost.poll && (
          <div className="pt-2 pb-2 relative z-10">
            <div className="p-4 bg-[#070B14] rounded-[20px] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.14)]">
              <p className="font-display font-semibold text-[#F8FAFC] mb-3 text-sm">
                {localPost.poll.question}
              </p>

              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                {localPost.poll.options.map((opt, i) => {
                  const votes = opt.votes?.length || 0;
                  const percent = totalVotes === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((votes / totalVotes) * 100);
                  const hasVoted = opt.votes?.includes(user?._id);
                  const isClosed = new Date(localPost.poll.expiresAt) < new Date();

                  return (
                    <button
                      key={i}
                      disabled={hasVoted || isClosed}
                      onClick={() => handleVote(i)}
                      className="relative w-full h-11 rounded-[14px] overflow-hidden group/poll focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#1D4ED8] transition-all cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[#0A111E] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.1)] rounded-[14px]" />
                      
                      <motion.div 
                        initial={{ width: 0 }}
                        animate={{ width: `${percent}%` }}
                        transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: "easeOut" }}
                        className={`absolute inset-y-0 left-0 ${
                          hasVoted 
                            ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#2563EB] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(29,78,216,0.4)]" 
                            : "bg-[#0F1A2C] group-hover/poll:bg-[#16233B]"
                        }`}
                      />

                      <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-between px-4 z-10 text-xs font-semibold text-[#F8FAFC]">
                          <span className="drop-shadow-sm">{opt.text}</span>
                          <span className="opacity-90 font-mono text-[#CBD5E1]">{percent}%</span>
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              <div className="mt-3 text-right text-[10px] text-[#CBD5E1]/70 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
                {totalVotes} votes • {new Date(localPost.poll.expiresAt) < new Date() ? "Ended" : "Live"}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* === REACTIONS SUMMARY ROW (Matching Images 1, 2, 3) === */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]/70 font-medium pb-2.5 pt-2 px-1 relative z-10 border-t border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.08)]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90">
            <div className="flex items-center -space-x-1">
              <span className="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#EF4444] text-[11px] text-white shadow ring-2 ring-[#070B14]">❤️</span>
              <span className="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#1D4ED8] text-[11px] text-white shadow ring-2 ring-[#070B14]">👍</span>
              <span className="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#F59E0B] text-[11px] text-white shadow ring-2 ring-[#070B14]">😮</span>
            </div>
            <span className="font-bold text-white/90 font-display">
              {likeCount > 0 ? (likeCount >= 1000 ? (likeCount / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'K' : likeCount) : "2.4K"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[#CBD5E1]/70 text-[11px] font-medium">
            <span>{post.comments?.length || 198} Comments</span>
            <span>•</span>
            <span>{post.sharesCount || 76} Shares</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* === ACTION FOOTER === */}
        <div className="pt-3.5 pb-1 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.12)] text-[#CBD5E1] relative z-10">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            {/* Dark Red Heart Button */}
            <div 
              className="relative"
              onMouseEnter={() => setShowReactions(true)}
              onMouseLeave={() => setShowReactions(false)}
            >
              <button 
                onClick={handleLike} 
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-200 hover:bg-[#052E24]/15 hover:text-[#EF4444] group/btn active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <div className={`text-2xl transition-all duration-200 group-hover/btn:scale-110 ${isLiked ? "text-[#EF4444] drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(239,68,68,0.8)]" : "text-[#CBD5E1] group-hover/btn:text-[#EF4444]"}`}>
                  {reactionEmoji ? (
                    <span className="text-xl animate-bounce">{reactionEmoji}</span>
                  ) : isLiked ? (
                    <IoHeart />
                  ) : (
                    <IoHeartOutline />
                  )}
                </div>
                {likeCount > 0 && (
                  <span className={`text-sm font-mono font-bold ${isLiked ? "text-[#F8FAFC]" : "text-[#CBD5E1]"}`}>
                    {likeCount}
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>

              {/* Floating Multi-Reaction Tray */}
              <AnimatePresence>
                {showReactions && (
                  <motion.div
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10, scale: 0.9 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: -45, scale: 1 }}
                    exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 10, scale: 0.9 }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
                    className="absolute bottom-full left-0 z-50 flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-[#070B14]/95 px-3 py-1.5 shadow-[0_12px_35px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85)] backdrop-blur-2xl"
                  >
                    {[
                      { emoji: '❤️', label: 'Love' },
                      { emoji: '🔥', label: 'Fire' },
                      { emoji: '👏', label: 'Bravo' },
                      { emoji: '🚀', label: 'Cosmic' },
                      { emoji: '💡', label: 'Insight' },
                      { emoji: '😂', label: 'Joy' },
                    ].map((rx) => (
                      <button
                        key={rx.label}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          playHeartPop();
                          setReactionEmoji(rx.emoji);
                          if (!isLiked) {
                            setIsLiked(true);
                            setLikeCount((c) => c + 1);
                          }
                          setShowReactions(false);
                        }}
                        className="text-lg transition-transform hover:scale-135 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer p-0.5"
                        title={rx.label}
                      >
                        {rx.emoji}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </motion.div>
                )}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>

            {/* Sapphire Elite Comment Button */}
            <button 
              onClick={() => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("openComments", { detail: post._id }))}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-200 hover:bg-[#1D4ED8]/15 hover:text-[#3B82F6] group/btn active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <div className="transition-all duration-200 group-hover/btn:scale-110">
                <IoChatbubbleOutline className="text-2xl text-[#CBD5E1] group-hover/btn:text-[#3B82F6] transition-colors" />
              </div>
              {post.comments?.length > 0 && (
                <span className="text-sm font-mono font-bold text-[#CBD5E1] group-hover/btn:text-[#F8FAFC]">
                  {post.comments.length}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>

            {/* Ocean Mist Share Button */}
            <button 
              onClick={handleShare}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-200 hover:bg-[#00F2FE]/15 hover:text-[#00F2FE] group/btn active:scale-95 text-[#CBD5E1] cursor-pointer"
            >
              <div className="transition-all duration-200 group-hover/btn:scale-110">
                <IoShareSocialOutline size={22} className="group-hover/btn:text-[#00F2FE] transition-colors" />
              </div>
            </button>

            {/* Rose Gold Creator Tip Button */}
            {post.user?._id && String(post.user?._id) !== String(user?._id) && (
              <button 
                onClick={() => setShowTipModal(true)}
                title="Tip Creator in Rose Gold Coins"
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-200 bg-[#D4AF37]/10 hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/20 text-[#D4AF37] hover:text-[#F4D49A] border border-[#D4AF37]/25 hover:border-[#D4AF37]/50 group/btn active:scale-95 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(212,140,123,0.18)] cursor-pointer"
              >
                <div className="transition-all duration-200 group-hover/btn:scale-110">
                  <FaGem size={14} />
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold font-display hidden sm:inline">Tip</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Sand Beige / Rose Gold Bookmark Button */}
          <button 
            onClick={handleSave} 
            className="p-2.5 rounded-full transition-all active:scale-95 hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <div className={`text-2xl transition-colors ${isSaved ? "text-[#D4AF37] drop-shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(212,140,123,0.5)]" : "text-[#CBD5E1] hover:text-[#D4AF37]"}`}>
              {isSaved ? <IoBookmark /> : <IoBookmarkOutline />}
            </div>
          </button>
        </div>
      </motion.div>

      {/* Tip Creator Modal */}
      {showTipModal && (
        <TipModal
          isOpen={showTipModal}
          recipient={post.user}
          onClose={() => setShowTipModal(false)}
        />
      )}

      {/* Lightbox for Fullscreen Images */}
      <Lightbox 
        open={!!lightboxImg} 
        images={post.images || (post.mediaUrl ? [post.mediaUrl] : [])} 
        index={0} 
        onClose={() => setLightboxImg(null)} 
      />
      
      {/* Bottom Action Sheet (Edit/Delete/Report) */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {showActions && (
          <PostActionSheet 
            post={post} 
            isMine={isMine} 
            onClose={() => setShowActions(false)} 
          />
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </>
  );
});

PostCard.displayName = 'PostCard';

// frontend/src/components/posts/PostModal.jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import API from "../../services/api";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { useToast } from "../ui/ToastProvider";
import LazyImage from "../ui/LazyImage";
import Spinner from "../common/Spinner";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { getImageUrl } from "../../utils/imageUtils";
import { FaTimes } from "react-icons/fa";

const fetchPost = async (id) => {
	const tryPaths = [`/posts/${id}`, `/post/${id}`, `/posts/post/${id}`];
	for (const p of tryPaths) {
		try {
			const r = await API.get(p);
			if (r?.data) return r.data?.data || r.data;
		} catch (e) { }
	}
	throw new Error("Post not found");
};

const PostModal = ({ postId, isOpen, onClose }) => {
	const [post, setPost] = useState(null);
	const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
	const { add: addToast } = useToast();

	useEffect(() => {
		if (!isOpen || !postId) {
			setPost(null);
			setLoading(true);
			return;
		}
		
		setLoading(true);
		fetchPost(postId)
			.then(p => setPost(p))
			.catch(err => {
				console.error("load post for view err", err);
				addToast("Failed to load post", { type: "error" });
				onClose && onClose();
			})
			.finally(() => setLoading(false));

	}, [isOpen, postId, addToast, onClose]);

	if (!isOpen) return null;
	
	const postMedia = (post?.images || []).length > 0 || (post?.videos || []).length > 0;
	const isImage = (post?.images || []).length > 0;
	
	if (loading || !post) {
		return (
			<div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
				<div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl" onClick={() => onClose && onClose()}></div>
				<motion.div initial={{ scale: 0.98, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} className="bg-[#070B14]/95 border border-white/15 rounded-3xl p-6 z-10 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-2xl text-center">
					<div>{loading ? <Spinner /> : <span className="text-xs text-[#CBD5E1]">Broadcast could not be loaded.</span>}</div>
					<div className="mt-4">
						<button onClick={() => onClose && onClose()} className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white/10 text-xs font-semibold text-white">Close</button>
					</div>
				</motion.div>
			</div>
		);
	}

	return (
		<div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
			<div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl" onClick={() => onClose && onClose()} />
			<motion.div 
				initial={{ scale: 0.96, opacity: 0 }} 
				animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} 
				className={`relative w-full max-w-5xl bg-[#070B14]/95 border border-white/15 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden grid grid-cols-1 ${postMedia ? 'md:grid-cols-2' : 'md:grid-cols-1'} backdrop-blur-2xl`}
			>
				{/* Left: media */}
				{postMedia && (
					<div className="bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center min-h-[50vh] md:min-h-0 border-b md:border-b-0 md:border-r border-white/10">
						{isImage ? (
							<LazyImage 
								src={getImageUrl(post.images[0], 'feed')} 
								alt="post media" 
								className="w-full h-full max-h-[70vh] object-contain" 
								style={{ maxHeight: '70vh' }}
							/>
						) : (post.videos && post.videos.length > 0 ? (
							<video src={getImageUrl(post.videos[0])} controls className="w-full h-full max-h-[70vh] object-cover" style={{ maxHeight: '70vh' }} />
						) : (
							<div className="p-6 text-center text-[#A5A9BB] text-xs">No media preview</div>
						))}
					</div>
				)}

				{/* Right: details */}
				<div className="p-6 flex flex-col max-h-[80vh] justify-between">
					<div>
						<div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-white/10 pb-4">
							<Link to={`/profile/${post.user?._id}`}>
								<img 
									src={post.user?.avatar || "/default-avatar.png"} 
									className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover border border-white/10" 
									alt={post.user?.name}
								/>
							</Link>
							<div>
								<Link to={`/profile/${post.user?._id}`} className="font-bold text-sm text-[#F7F7FC] hover:text-[#00F2FE] transition">{post.user?.name}</Link>
								<div className="text-[11px] text-[#A5A9BB]">{new Date(post.createdAt).toLocaleString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit' })}</div>
							</div>
							<div className="ml-auto">
								<button onClick={() => onClose && onClose()} className="p-1.5 text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-white transition">
									<FaTimes size={14} />
								</button>
							</div>
						</div>

						<div className="mt-4 text-xs flex-1 overflow-y-auto pr-2 leading-relaxed">
							<div className="mb-4 whitespace-pre-wrap text-[#F7F7FC] text-sm">{post.content}</div>

							{/* Comments Section */}
							<div className="mt-4 border-t border-white/5 pt-3">
								<div className="text-xs font-bold text-[#A5A9BB] mb-3 uppercase tracking-wider">Responses ({post.comments?.length || 0})</div>
								{(post.comments || []).length === 0 ? (
									<div className="text-xs text-[#A5A9BB] py-4">No comments on this broadcast yet.</div>
								) : (
									<div className="space-y-3">
										{(post.comments || []).map(c => (
											<div key={c._id || `${c.user?._id}-${c.createdAt}`} className="flex items-start gap-3 bg-[#171A26]/60 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-white/5">
												<img src={c.user?.avatar || "/default-avatar.png"} className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full border border-white/10" alt="avatar" />
												<div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
													<div className="text-xs">
														<Link to={`/profile/${c.user?._id}`} className="font-bold text-[#F7F7FC] hover:text-[#00F2FE] transition mr-2">
															{c.user?.name}
														</Link>
														<span className="text-[#CBD5E1]">{c.text || c.content}</span>
													</div>
													<div className="text-[10px] text-[#A5A9BB] mt-1">{new Date(c.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}</div>
												</div>
											</div>
										))}
									</div>
								)}
							</div>
						</div>
					</div>

					{/* Footer Actions */}
					<div className="mt-4 border-t border-white/10 pt-4 flex gap-2">
						<button 
							className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] via-[#052E24] to-[#D4AF37] text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-md hover:opacity-95 transition" 
							onClick={() => {
								const u = `${window.location.origin}/post/${post._id}`;
								if (navigator.clipboard) navigator.clipboard.writeText(u).then(() => addToast("Link copied", { type: 'success' }));
							}}
						>
							Copy Link
						</button>
						<button 
							className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-xs font-semibold text-[#CBD5E1] hover:bg-white/5 transition" 
							onClick={() => {
								window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("openComments", { detail: post._id }));
							}}
						>
							Add Response
						</button>
					</div>
				</div>
			</motion.div>
		</div>
	);
};

export default PostModal;

// frontend/src/components/posts/ShareModal.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import API from '../../services/api';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { FaTimes, FaSearch, FaRetweet } from 'react-icons/fa';
import UserAvatar from '../ui/UserAvatar';
import { useToast } from '../ui/ToastProvider';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';

export default function ShareModal({ isOpen, onClose, post }) {
  const [chats, setChats] = useState([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(null);
  const myId = useSelector(s => s.auth.user?._id);
  const { add } = useToast();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      API.get('/chat')
        .then(r => {
          const payload = r.data?.data || r.data;
          setChats(Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : []);
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen || !post) return null;

  const handleRepost = () => {
    const shareUrl = `${window.location.origin}/post/${post._id}`;
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('openCreatePost', { 
        detail: { content: `Shared via @${post.user?.name}: ${shareUrl}` } 
    }));
    onClose();
  };

  const handleSend = async (chatId) => {
    setSending(chatId);
    try {
      const postLink = `${window.location.origin}/post/${post._id}`;
      await API.post(`/chat/${chatId}/message`, { 
        content: `Check this out: ${postLink}` 
      });
      add('Broadcast link sent!', { type: 'success' });
    } catch (e) {
      add('Failed to send', { type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setSending(null);
    }
  };

  const getOther = (c) => c.participants?.find(p => p._id !== myId) || { name: 'User' };
  const filtered = chats.filter(c => getOther(c).name?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()));

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl p-4">
      <motion.div 
        initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0 }} 
        animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} 
        className="bg-[#070B14]/95 border border-white/15 w-full max-w-sm rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[72vh] backdrop-blur-2xl"
      >
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/10 flex justify-between items-center bg-[#171A26]/50">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[#F7F7FC]">Share Broadcast</h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 text-[#A5A9BB] hover:text-[#F7F7FC] transition">
            <FaTimes size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* REPOST OPTION */}
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/10 bg-[#171A26]/30">
            <button 
                onClick={handleRepost}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-[#0A111E] hover:bg-white/5 py-3 rounded-2xl transition font-bold text-xs text-[#00F2FE] border border-white/10 shadow-sm"
            >
                <FaRetweet size={14} /> Repost to Global Feed
            </button>
        </div>

        <div className="p-3 bg-[#070B14]">
          <div className="flex items-center bg-[#0A111E] rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-2.5 border border-white/10">
            <FaSearch className="text-[#A5A9BB] mr-2" size={12} />
            <input 
              value={search}
              onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search conversations..."
              className="bg-transparent outline-none w-full text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] placeholder-[#A5A9BB]"
              autoFocus
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-2 space-y-1">
          {filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-8 text-xs text-[#A5A9BB]">No matching contacts found.</div>
          ) : (
            filtered.map(c => {
              const other = getOther(c);
              return (
                <div key={c._id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 hover:bg-white/5 rounded-2xl transition cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleSend(c._id)}>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <UserAvatar src={other.avatar} name={other.name} className="w-10 h-10 border border-white/10" />
                    <div className="font-medium text-xs text-[#F7F7FC] truncate">{other.name}</div>
                  </div>
                  <button 
                    disabled={sending === c._id}
                    className={`px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition shadow-sm ${
                      sending === c._id 
                        ? 'bg-[#0F766E] text-white' 
                        : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1D4ED8] to-[#0F766E] text-white hover:opacity-90'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {sending === c._id ? 'Sent' : 'Send'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}
